title: The revival of Terranigma
dek: A celebrated game absent from official North American release for three decades is becoming a test of preservation, access, and whether availability can change a canon.
whyTracked: The revival has a concrete release window, a historically unusual access correction, and observable questions about technical preservation and cultural reception.

current.assessment: The product and broad platform plan are established. Exact timing, regional behavior, technical fidelity, and the effect of lawful access remain unknown.
current.nextReviewTrigger: Review for a firm release date, delay, preservation details, launch comparisons, or later audience and scholarship indicators.

openQuestions: Will the revival arrive in early 2027?
Which regional timing and technical behaviors will be preserved or corrected?
Will official availability materially broaden the game’s audience and critical standing?

watchFor.trigger: The publisher or storefront supplies a firm date.

watchFor.description: Technical and preservation analysis of the released version
watchFor.trigger: Independent comparisons document timing, localization, assets, input, and emulation behavior.
Sales indicators, player counts, criticism, or new scholarship show whether access changed the game’s cultural reach.

observations.headline: Point-zero observation
observations.summary: Clear River Games and Square Enix announced a multi-platform Terranigma revival for early 2027, including the game’s first official North American release.

observations.headline: Admitted to The Wake pilot
observations.summary: Admitted because the project can be followed from announcement through technical comparison and eventually into evidence about audience and critical reach.
